name: remotion
description: Remotion: videos made from code (React). LOKI scaffolds a project in the workspace (video_project) and renders it to MP4 (render_video); both ask first, because rendering runs the project's code.
license: Remotion License: free for individuals and companies with up to 3 employees; larger companies need a company licence
install: Needs Node 18+ (npx). Nothing global is installed: npx fetches Remotion into each video project. python tools/setup_extras.py remotion checks it.
notice: Remotion is not free for every company: it is free for individuals and companies with up to 3 employees. Check remotion.dev/license before using it for a bigger company.
